Running command: python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
# Build a candidate using the exact v1 length boundary and no trailing HTTP tail.
p=b'PROXY TCP4 127.0.0.1 127.0.0.1 1 1\r\n'
Path('/workspace/poc_v1_boundary.bin').write_bytes(p)
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"fuzz_parse_http_request","line":1624,"var":"request->flags","code":".flags = REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS","note":"The harness permits proxy protocol parsing for the attacker-supplied input."},
{"step":2,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"read_request_finalizer","line":888,"var":"helper->buffer->len","code":"char *crlfcrlf = memmem(helper->buffer->value, helper->buffer->len, \"\\r\\n\\r\\n\", 4);","note":"The input contains the required request terminator, so it passes the finalizer gate."},
{"step":3,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1170,"var":"request->flags","code":"if (request->flags & REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS) { buffer = parse_proxy_protocol(request, buffer); }","note":"Parsing is diverted into the PROXY protocol handler."},
{"step":4,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":165,"var":"end","code":"end = memchr(buffer, '\\r', line_size);","note":"The parser scans only the first 108 bytes for the CR terminator, so the line length is bounded by this constant."},
{"step":5,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":169,"var":"size","code":"size = (unsigned int) (end + 2 - buffer);","note":"The accepted header length is derived directly from the attacker-controlled line extent."},
{"step":6,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_proxy_protocol_v1","line":171,"var":"protocol/src_addr/dst_addr/src_port/dst_port","code":"protocol = buffer + sizeof(\"PROXY \") - 1; src_addr = strsep_char(protocol, ' '); ...","note":"The header is tokenized in place, mutating the original input buffer."},
{"step":7,"file":"src/lib/lwan-request.c","function":"parse_http_request","line":1184,"var":"buffer","code":"buffer = ignore_leading_whitespace(buffer);","note":"If the header were mishandled, HTTP parsing would continue on a corrupted post-header boundary."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print('/workspace/poc_v1_boundary.bin')
PY
